title: Becoming An Agent of Change Pt. 2
paragraphs: Our focus will be on understanding the principle and power of influence. Understanding the principle and power of influence. Specifically, I want to focus in this session on the original design and purpose of the church. The focus is on the word "original" because the church I see today is not the one founded by Jesus Christ. I am not standing here as someone who criticizes the church in a negative way.

But I am here to address the question of whether we are true to the mission, the design, and the original purpose of our existence. So I want to focus specifically in the next few minutes —and please take notes with me—on the original design and purpose of the church as we focus on becoming agents of change. I want to go over very quickly what we talked about in our last session for some reason. Firstly, all humans live under the shadow of time and change. All humans will be affected by time and change.

Whoever controls and manages time and change will control our experience within time and change. In other words, whoever plans your time and the changes in your life controls your future. This is why we become victims of the people to whom we give our time and our changes. Most of these people may not put your interests first. Who are the people we entrust most of our time and changes to? First, our politicians. In a way, we believe they will always work in our favor.

And so we surrender to them our will, our time, and our changes. We call that voting. In essence, others can plan your life for you if you don't plan your life yourself. And I say this with great fear: the greater part of your life has been planned by someone else. Think about where you are now physically, economically, psychologically, socially, and politically. Someone planned it. For example, when you go to a grocery store and buy a can of beans, who is in control of you?

Which company put the toxins in that can of beans to preserve them? The poison enters your body when you eat beans. The toxin then reacts with enzymes in your body to create a cancerous cell called a free radical cell. This cell remains in your body, perhaps for up to 10 years, and then one day it finds the right conditions to turn into a tumor and begin to multiply. The person who sold you the can of beans bears no responsibility for your death. Who really controls your life?

Most of you have never been to Parliament. You never sat in that building while they made decisions about your children, your health, and your future. However, when laws are enacted, we live according to them without having the opportunity to participate in making them. Whoever plans your time and your changes controls your future. I think the question is: Who will design your life? I want the answer to that with this question or with this phrase.

Avoiding engagement with the forces that design and plan our time and changes is surrendering to someone else's values, morals, and standards. I repeat, if you avoid dealing with the powers that you have given the authority to plan your time and change you, you have surrendered your entire life to their morals and standards. You become a victim of what they want.

For this reason, in a democratic society, it is very dangerous to leave your future to those to whom you have given the right to decide what happens to your life. You must remain involved. Therefore, the first weakness and flaw in the church is its lack of participation in planning for the nation. I call it a useless church. The folly of the Church lies in its preoccupation with planning for Heaven and not for Earth. The Church planned for itself to completely withdraw from this world.

Her theology became based on renouncing the world and the earth. The Church created and designed its own irrelevance by making itself irrelevant, because it is so preoccupied with heavenly things. In most cases, it is useless on Earth. Every other entity on Earth has a plan to influence and control the changes in our society. Every other group, from politicians, lawyers, legislators, and those in the pharmaceutical industry and the medical profession, all have their own plans for what they want for society.

Most of the time, the church plans to leave the community. Here is my advice. If we don't plan our lives, someone else will. This is dangerous. Therefore, the best way to predict the future is to design and create it yourself. This calls for participation. In other words, planning is when you set the agenda for the future. We've been talking about planning for the past six weeks. How should you plan the change you want? Every group in society has an agenda to change the world in a way that serves its interests.

The church's agenda is to take people out of the world and out of the earth. As I said in the last session, the world accepts our agenda. They are happy because we said we would not interfere in their affairs. The church has become a target of ridicule, criticism, contempt, and abuse. We have become like a sideshow where they mock the priests and talk about the laziness of the church and its lack of involvement in social development.

And how the church steals people's money and how it does not care about their needs. These are the attacks on this organization that you call the Church. The church is also used as a social tool by secular society to legitimize its interests. In other words, the church is used as a voting bloc in political processes, with representatives only coming to the church when they want to gain your support. You know, I was listening to the Secretary of State and I have the CD in my car.

I've already listened to it seven times. He said, and I am quoting him. He said: "The only reason I would go anywhere is politics." End of quote. That shocked me. He repeated that three times in the House of Representatives last week. He said, "When you see me anywhere, there's no need to wonder why I'm there." I am quoting him. Everything is politics. He says, and this means that if he ever comes to this church, we know that he did not come to hear from God. He did not come to receive the word.

He did not come to pray. Everything is politics. I hope this is not true for the other MPs. I hope that you will not use funerals, church meetings and church conferences for political motives. May God punish you for that. We are not a tool to be manipulated for the political gain of others or even for social advancement. There are people who use the church for their own business interests.

They come to a church like this one, which has over 2,000 people today, and they come to sell Amway products, or they want to promote their Shackley cereal. Sometimes they come up to me and say, "Pastor Miles, if you would allow me to say a few words to the church, you would get 10%." They are trying to use me to abuse you. This is demonic. The Church of God should never be used to achieve the results of your own business dealings. This is an organization and a sacred entity. But it happens.

The church has lost its way because it doesn't even know its own way. Sometimes the success of God's kingdom on earth lies in initiating and planning for change, not avoiding it. I want to present to you God's agenda. I want to repeat that again. Please go to John, chapter three. We will return to the Book of Genesis in a minute. John 3:16 is God's agenda. It is a very familiar verse, yet it is one we do not know.

She says: "For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in what that Son teaches shall not perish but have eternal life." The following verse is important. Read it again. Because God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world. Why? Because the world needs to be saved through him. Amen. Now look how many times the word "world" has been used. I want to explain this again, just as I did last time. The Earth and the world are not the same thing.

Jesus Christ did not mention in this text that he came to save the earth. He said he came to save what? the world. The world and the earth. They are not the same thing. Let me prove it to you. The Bible contains two different versions of these two words. The first word, Earth, is the Greek word "Ge" in the New Testament and its equivalent in the Old Testament, and it means the physical planet. It means soil, like trees, mountains, and water. This is "G", the Earth. The world is something different.

The word "world" is a different word in the Bible. It is the word "Cosmos". K W Z M W S. It means systems of control, systems of governance, forces of control, or forces of influence. It's a powerful word. So when the Bible says, "For God so loved the world," it is not talking about mountains, oceans, and trees. He is talking about the systems that govern the Earth. The Bible says the earth is pure, but the world is already condemned. Condemned means that God has already condemned our systems. Which systems?

I gave you a list. I want you to write it down. There are 12 systems on Earth called the world. Write it down. The first is the political system. It is the word cosmos used in the Bible. She is referring to this. It's a system of control. The second world is the world of government. Don't confuse government with politics. They are different. Politics is the process of entering government. The government is the system that controls what happens in a piece of land called a homeland. This is a system.

The third system is the legislative authority. This is the law. The world of law controls our way of life. The fourth world is the world of economics. This is the world that controls our financial experiences dealing with employment and banks. The fifth world is the world of culture. Culture controls people's lifestyles. This is a world. Then there is the world of civil society where we try to live together and be civilized. This is a world. Someone is using that to control the land.

Then the seventh world is called the world of social life, or we call it society. How we live together as a family, how we treat each other, and how we trust those we do business with. This is our social world. Then, in eighth place, comes the world of arts. This is a big world. It's a powerful world. The world of people who deal with music, movies, drama, dance, and those who deal with the internet. Those who shape entertainment. This is a world. Then there is the world of education. This is a world.

It's a powerful world. It is the place where you put your children for seven hours a day where they control your child's mind. This is a world. Then there is the number eight, or rather the number ten. The world of medicine and health. This is a world. This world is powerful. This world can destroy your life or give you life. What happens in that world is important to you. The most important thing you have in your body right now is your health. People can manipulate your health and destroy you.

They say that most people die in hospitals from incorrect prescriptions rather than from the diseases themselves. This means that our number two government system needs to review the policies they use to monitor the medical system because most of the medical staff are still in training. She wonders why they call it a medical practice. Hmm. And you know, we have some great doctors in this hall. They will sometimes tell you that they do not know what the patient is suffering from. So they are experimenting.

They are still practicing the profession. That's why lawyers are also dangerous. They are always practicing the profession. These are worlds. She is strong. Number 11. The business world. It's a powerful world. It controls your life. Then there is the religious scholar. Oh my God, this world is dangerous too, because it controls the morals of society. There is a lost world. I want to add it to it. It's the world of sports and physical activity. It's a powerful world. Jesus said that this is a scholar.

Billions of dollars flow through the hands of the sports industry. These worlds are what the word " cosmos" refers to. Each one of them affects the Earth. So, the challenge is whether the church is supposed to leave those worlds to those worlds? I want you to think about something. Write this down. The church and the kingdom are not synonymous. Do not confuse the church with the kingdom of God. The Kingdom existed before the Church. Jesus Christ never preached in the church. He mentioned the word church only once.

Just once. And that was never public. He mentioned the church in a private meeting with twelve men. He never said it publicly. This was during a conversation in which he was talking about the impact. He started the conversation with a question. Who do people say I am? That's how that conversation began. They were silent because they did not know the answer. Then one of them said, "Some people say that you are a prophet." Others say that you are Elijah. That is a prophet. Some people say that you are Elias.

That is a prophet. Some say that you are John the Baptist who has risen from the dead. That is a prophet. Some of them say that you are the Prophet. That is a prophet. They are all prophets. Every answer was wrong. This is important. Jesus Christ was not a prophet. Muhammad is a prophet. Baha'u'llah is a prophet. Joseph Smith was a prophet. Mormons. Christ was never a prophet. Do not put Jesus Christ in the same category as Muhammad. Muhammad was a prophet. Why is this important?

Because the prophets, whoever they may be, speak on behalf of their God. If you are God, you don't need anyone to speak for you when you arrive. You'd better wake up here for a moment. The prophets say, "Thus says the Lord," but when the Lord arrives, he says, "I say to you, " applaud him. He says, "I am who I am." Then Peter decided to answer the question because he received a text message on his phone from heaven. The text message read: " Tell him, you are the Messiah, the Son of the living God."

He is not a son, but the Son is the living God. The word Messiah, could you please write it? The word Christo used is “Mashiach” in Hebrew and “Messiah” in English. It does not mean a prophet. Most politicians want Jesus to be a prophet because they want to keep him out of their political affairs. That's why they say to the church: "Stay where you are." Just a moment. My boss is a politician and you are a politician. So, your place is my place. Some of you still haven't understood this. Based on this declaration that I am a king, I will build my church. He said that the fact that I am an anointed king gives me the authority to establish something on Earth. And the gates of hell cannot stop this entity that I have created. Amen. Don't you dare put me in that category. I am a citizen of the Kingdom. Amen. I was sent to Earth as a diplomat. I have my credentials. And my constitution is now in your hands.
